thread:
Maria Chen: Hey eng-platform — can someone take a look at PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1422 ? It's a customer (AcmeCorp) private-deploy patch: fixes mount path for k8s sidecar + adds header auth fallback. Need platform + security approval before their maintenance window tomorrow 23:00 UTC. CI is green but would like a quick sanity check. Thanks! :eyes:

Ajay Kumar: Taking a look now. Any specific test I should run against staging?

Maria Chen: Thanks! Steps are in the PR description. TL;DR: deploy to acme-staging, run smoke: `curl -H "X-Acme-Tenant: acme123" https://staging.acme.redwood/api/health` — should return 200 and header `X-Auth-Used=kv-fallback`. Logs in the PR show the failing mount path before the fix.

deploy-bot: CI passed — build 1422, all checks green. https://ci.redwood-inference/1422 :white_check_mark:

Sam Torres: I can repro the original failure locally, will validate the mount change tomorrow morning. :+1:

Tina Park: Quick scan — looks small. One security note: please make sure we don't log the full auth token during fallback. See inline comment.

Maria Chen: Good catch, Tina. I removed the debug log in the latest commit (force-push). Also added a unit test for the fallback.

Ajay Kumar: I left one nit about the k8s path env var naming. Could you rename `REDWOOD_K8S_MOUNT` -> `RW_K8S_MOUNT` to match other vars?

Maria Chen: Yep will update in a sec.

Maria Chen: Pushed rename and updated deployment template. CI triggered again: https://ci.redwood-inference/1422/2

deploy-bot: CI passed — build 1422.2 :white_check_mark:

security-bot: Quick review done — no secret exposure, the KV call is properly masked. Security signoff.

Tina Park: Looks good to me now. :shipit:

Ajay Kumar: Approve from platform side. We can merge during the customer's maintenance window; if they want earlier, we can stage a brownout rollout first.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. I'll schedule merge for tomorrow 23:05 UTC (maintenance window 23:00-23:30). Will monitor rollout and post status here. :rocket:

Maria Chen: Merged and deployed to acme-staging for verification. Will escalate if anything odd.

Sam Torres: Verified smoke on staging — 200 + header present. No regressions. :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: Deployed to prod in maintenance window, rollout healthy. Closing thread. :tada:
